blocks.prompt: 8 Find the square root of \(13 - 20\sqrt{3}i\) and represent them on an Argand diagram.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein do kaam hain: pehle \(13 - 20\sqrt{3}i\) ke do square roots nikalne hain (bilkul Question 7 ki tarah), phir unhein Argand diagram par plot karna hai.
Diya kya hai? \(x = 13\), \(y = -20\sqrt{3}\). Surd se ghabraiye nahi: \((20\sqrt{3})^2\) ek saaf number 1200 ban jata hai.
Rule kaunsa? Square root formula, aur plot ke liye yeh rule ke \(a + ib\) ka point \((a, b)\) hota hai.
Plan: \(|z|\), \(p\), \(q\), signs, tasdeeq, phir har root ko point bana kar diagram par lagana.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(z = 13 - 20\sqrt{3}i\).
Humein find karna hai: dono square roots, aur unhein Argand diagram par dikhana.
Tareeqa: Square root ka formula (Section 1.2.1): \(p = \sqrt{\frac{|z| + x}{2}}\), \(q = \sqrt{\frac{|z| - x}{2}}\); agar \(y > 0\) ho to \(\sqrt{z} = \pm(p + iq)\), aur \(y < 0\) ho to \(\pm(p - iq)\). Yeh formula kisi bhi \(x + iy\) ke dono square roots seedha de deta hai, is liye har dafa \((a + ib)^2\) expand kar ke equations banane ki zaroorat nahi. Sirf teen cheezein chahiye: \(x\), \(y\) ka sign, aur \(|z|\).

\(x\) aur \(y\) parhein
\[x = 13,\quad y = -20\sqrt{3} < 0\]
Kyun: Pehle number ko \(x + iy\) shakal mein dekh kar real part \(x\) aur imaginary part \(y\) pehchante hain. \(x\) formula mein jayega, aur \(y\) ka sign aakhir mein yeh tay karega ke jawab ke dono hisson ke signs ek jaise honge ya ulte. Is liye \(y\) ka sign abhi se note kar lein.

Modulus \(|z|\) nikalein
\[|z| = \sqrt{13^2 + (20\sqrt{3})^2}\]
\[= \sqrt{169 + 1200}\]
\[= \sqrt{1369} = 37\]
Kyun: Modulus \(|z| = \sqrt{x^2 + y^2}\) number ki origin se doori hai (jaise naqshe par ghar se school ka seedha faasla). Yeh \(p\) aur \(q\) dono ke formula mein chahiye, is liye pehle isay nikalte hain. Squares lene se minus khatam ho jata hai, is liye modulus hamesha positive hota hai. Yahan \((20\sqrt{3})^2 = 400 \times 3 = 1200\), kyunke \((\sqrt{3})^2 = 3\); aur \(37^2 = 1369\).

\(p\) nikalein
\[p = \sqrt{\dfrac{37 + 13}{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{25} = 5\]
Kyun: \(|z|\) aur \(x\) ko \(p = \sqrt{(|z| + x)/2}\) mein rakha. \(p\) jawab ka real part hai. \(37 + 13 = 50\), \(50/2 = 25\).

\(q\) nikalein
\[q = \sqrt{\dfrac{37 - 13}{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{12} = 2\sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: \(|z|\) aur \(x\) ko \(q = \sqrt{(|z| - x)/2}\) mein rakha. \(q\) jawab ke imaginary part ka size hai. \(37 - 13 = 24\), \(24/2 = 12\), \(\sqrt{12} = 2\sqrt{3}\).

Signs chunein
\[\sqrt{13 - 20\sqrt{3}i} = \pm(5 - 2\sqrt{3}\,i)\]
Kyun: \(y\) negative hai, is liye formula ka \(\pm(p - iq)\) wala hissa lagta hai: real part aur \(i\) wale part ke signs ulte honge. Wajah: root ka square karne par imaginary part \(2pq\) wale sign se aata hai; ulte signs hon to woh negative banta hai, jaisa \(y\) hai.

Tasdeeq: root ka square karein
\[(5 - 2\sqrt{3}\,i)^2\]
\[= 25 - 20\sqrt{3}\,i + 12i^2\]
\[= 13 - 20\sqrt{3}\,i \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \((2\sqrt{3})^2 = 12\), to \(12i^2 = -12\) aur \(25 - 12 = 13\); beech wala term \(2(5)(2\sqrt{3}\,i) = 20\sqrt{3}\,i\) minus ke saath. Square karne par wapas asal number aa gaya, is liye root sahi hai. Doosra root bas is ka negative hai, aur \((-w)^2 = w^2\), is liye woh bhi khud hi sahi hai. Yeh tasdeeq exam mein ek line mein ho jati hai aur ghalti foran pakar leti hai.

Roots ko Argand diagram par dikhayein
\[5 - 2\sqrt{3}\,i \to (5,\ -2\sqrt{3})\]
\[-5 + 2\sqrt{3}\,i \to (-5,\ 2\sqrt{3})\]
\[2\sqrt{3} \approx 3.46\]
Kyun: Argand diagram ko shehar ka naqsha samjhiye jis mein do seedhi sarkein hain: horizontal sarak real axis (\(x\)-axis) aur vertical sarak imaginary axis (\(y\)-axis). Har complex number \(a + ib\) ek point \((a, b)\) hai: \(a\) qadam daayen ya baayen, \(b\) qadam upar ya neeche. Pehla root \((5, -3.46)\) quadrant IV mein (daayen aur neeche) aur doosra \((-5, 3.46)\) quadrant II mein (baayen aur upar). Dono origin \(O\) ke aar paar bilkul aamne saamne hain, kyunke ek root doosre ka negative hai.
Dhyan dein: Point plot karte waqt \(i\) nahi likhte; \(-2\sqrt{3}\,i\) ka matlab \(y\)-coordinate \(-2\sqrt{3}\) hai, jo taqreeban \(-3.46\) hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\sqrt{13 - 20\sqrt{3}i} = \pm(5 - 2\sqrt{3}\,i)\): Argand diagram par points \((5, -2\sqrt{3})\) aur \((-5, 2\sqrt{3})\)
Yeh dono points origin ke aar paar ek seedhi line par aamne saamne hain.

Two points are plotted: 5 minus 2 root 3 i at (5, about -3.46) in the fourth quadrant, and -5 plus 2 root 3 i at (-5, about 3.46) in the second quadrant. A dashed line joins them through the origin.
